newsitem.title: UK: European vegetable oil prices mixed in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: European vegetable oil prices mixed in quiet trade.

text.p: European vegetable oil prices were mixed at midday on Friday with business restricted ahead of the long holiday weekend.
Most of Europe will be closed on Monday May 16 for the Whitsum holiday, but the UK will be working normally.
Traders said the lack of any firm lead from Chicago overnight was also dampening enthusiasm.

Palm oil looks set to decline with traders in Asia in pessimistic mood following the release on Thursday of lower than expected Malaysian palm oil export figures for April by the Malaysian Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA).
PORLA put April exports at 570,067 tonnes against trade expectations of 600,000 to 610,000 tonnes.
At midday crude palm oil cif Europe and RBD palm oil were $2.50 lower with no business reported.
Olein offers were unchanged to $2.50 up after Jun traded at $585 and Jul at $572.50 a tonne fob Malaysian ports.
Coconut oil was mixed after Thursday's shake out with offers $2.50 up to $2.50 down after May/Jun traded at $647.50 and Jun/Jul at $642.50 a tonne cif.
Palmkernel oil sellers were $5 up with no follow through business from Thursday seen so far.
In the soft oil sector soy oil was 0.75 to 0.50 guilders up and rape oil 0.50 guilders higher to 0.25 guilders lower in a so far neglected market.
